extracted.intended_audience: film & television production companies, publicists, advertisers, publishers and others producing advertising, promotional or editorial materials that refer to SAG-AFTRA awards or symbols
extracted.subtask_description: Official legal guidelines for use of SAG-AFTRA names, registered marks, The Actor® statuette and other proprietary intellectual property in advertising, promotion, packaging and editorial contexts. Specifies when permission is required, required notices, size/placement limits, and conditions for recipients and nominees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose and anti-misleading objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the rights of past and future recipients are protected; prevent false claims of Screen Actors Guild Award consideration; avoid misleading the public about whether a performer has received or been nominated for a Screen Actors Guild Award; and provide legal protection for SAG-AFTRA's trademarks and copyright.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These four objectives frame all regulations and are the basis for restrictions on use of marks, images and statements in all advertising, promotion and editorial materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright ownership and exclusive rights in The Actor® statuette
rubrics_metrics.description: The Actor® statuette is the copyrighted property of SAG-AFTRA. SAG-AFTRA has the sole and exclusive right to reproduce, manufacture, copy, sell, display images of and publish the statuette in any size or medium.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No reproduction, replica, drawing, photograph, derivative work nor other copy of The Actor® statuette may be made or used by any manufacturer, advertiser, organization nor individual except in accordance with these regulations or under express written license from SAG-AFTRA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Published representations must include copyright legend
rubrics_metrics.description: All published representations of The Actor® statuette, including photographs, drawings and other likenesses, must include the legend “©1995 SAG-AFTRA.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The copyright notice must accompany the depiction in legible form wherever representations are published, including advertising, packaging and editorial uses (repeated requirement across sections II, III, IV).

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered trademark restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: The trade names “The Actor,” “Screen Actors Guild Awards,” “The SAG Awards,” and “Screen Actor” are registered trademarks of SAG-AFTRA and may not be used except in accordance with these regulations or under a special written license from SAG-AFTRA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unlicensed use of these marks is prohibited across advertising, packaging, titles, and promotional materials unless expressly permitted by the regulations or a written license.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark/service mark notice and owner credit required
rubrics_metrics.description: Any use of the marks “The Actor,” “Screen Actors Guild Awards” and “The SAG Awards” must include notice of trademark and service mark registration and credit SAG-AFTRA as the registered owner of said marks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where marks are used the materials must include appropriate notice of trademark/service mark ownership and credit to SAG-AFTRA as set forth in the Regulations (examples of exact credit phrasing provided for packaging).

rubrics_metrics.name: Permission generally required for use of symbols outside fair-use hard-news reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Permission to use Screen Actors Guild Awards symbols and institutional marks of SAG-AFTRA for any publication in other than fair use hard-news reporting must be obtained in writing from SAG-AFTRA, except that permission is hereby given to use symbols and marks in accordance with these Regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your intended use is not covered by the specific permitted uses in these Regulations, you must obtain written permission from SAG-AFTRA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on using The Actor® as a generic logo or decorative motif
rubrics_metrics.description: The Actor® statuette may not be used in generic fashion as a logo or decorative motif for any purpose in any video or television production, motion picture, or print or digital publication not produced by, or explicitly authorized by, SAG-AFTRA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This prohibition covers incidental or decorative uses; licensed exceptions may be considered only under unusual circumstances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on using The Actor® as stage property or set dressing
rubrics_metrics.description: The Actor® statuette may not be used as a stage property or article of set dressing in any stage, television, video or motion picture production not produced by SAG-AFTRA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Licensed exceptions will be considered under unusual circumstances. Violations may subject performing individuals and theatrical films to loss of Screen Actors Guild Awards eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restriction on using 'The Actor' in titles/subtitles
rubrics_metrics.description: The mark, 'The Actor' (as relating to the outstanding performance award) may not be used in the title or subtitle of any magazine, digital publication, stage production, video, television program or motion picture not produced by SAG-AFTRA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use of 'Screen Actors Guild Awards' in titles/subtitles is allowed only with written consent (see related regulation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Title use of 'Screen Actors Guild Awards' requires written consent
rubrics_metrics.description: The mark, 'Screen Actors Guild Awards' may be used in the title or subtitle of a magazine, digital publication, stage production, video, television program or motion picture with the written consent of SAG-AFTRA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obtain written consent from SAG-AFTRA before incorporating the phrase into titles/subtitles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on incorporating marks into video/disc series titles or packaging
rubrics_metrics.description: The marks, 'The Actor,' 'Screen Actors Guild Awards,' 'The SAG Awards,' or any of them, may not be incorporated into a video cassette or disc series title or subtitle, either on packaging or in advertising for such motion pictures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such marks may be incorporated into the title or subtitle of an audio product only with the written permission of SAG-AFTRA.

rubrics_metrics.name: No ownership rights in statuette for recipients; resale restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: Recipients of The Actor® have no rights whatsoever in the copyright of The Actor® statuette or in its trademark and service mark registrations and must comply with these rules. Award recipients shall not sell or otherwise dispose of The Actor® statuette, nor permit it to be sold or disposed of by operation of law, without first offering to sell it to the Screen Actors Guild Awards for the sum of $1.00.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This provision also applies to heirs and assigns who may acquire a statuette by gift or bequest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Miniatures subject to same regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: Metal miniatures of The Actor® statuettes are subject to the same regulations as the standard size statuettes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All reproduction and usage rules that apply to standard statuettes also apply to miniatures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertising: consent required for use of recipient's image with marks
rubrics_metrics.description: No personal appearance, picture or drawing of a recipient of a Screen Actor Guild Award with a Screen Actors Guild Award symbol or SAG-AFTRA mark may be used in any advertising or promotional materials of any sort without the written consent of SAG-AFTRA except as permitted by these Regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This covers all advertising and promotional materials across media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertising: consent required for use of any reproduction of The Actor® in ads
rubrics_metrics.description: No Screen Actors Guild Award symbol nor any photograph, picture or drawing that includes a reproduction of The Actor® statuette or SAG-AFTRA mark may be used in any advertising appearing in newspapers, periodicals, billboards, posters or in any other medium, specifically including electronic media, without the written consent of SAG-AFTRA, except as permitted by these Regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Again, only uses expressly permitted by the Regulations or by written consent are allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowable depiction by recipients in advertising (conditions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Performers who have received The Actor® may use a depiction of The Actor® statuette in advertising provided certain conditions are met.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conditions: (i) It appears no more than once in each advertisement; (ii) The size of the depiction does not exceed ten percent of the total advertising space or viewing area; (iii) SAG-AFTRA approves the quality of the representation; (iv) The copyright, trademark, and service mark notice, “© 1995 SAG-AFTRA,” accompanies the depiction in legible form; and (v) The achievement for which the award was conferred is specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowable wording for recipients (display/legal notice conditions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Performers who have received The Actor® may use the words 'Recipient Screen Actors Guild Award' or 'Recipient of The Actor' or similar descriptions incorporating SAG-AFTRA marks provided conditions are met.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conditions: (i) Any visual display of SAG-AFTRA's marks is accompanied by an indication of the achievement for which the award was conferred; and (ii) SAG-AFTRA's marks appear with appropriate notice of trademark and service mark ownership and/or registration as set forth in these Regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowable use by nominees (timing, size, notice, wording)
rubrics_metrics.description: Performers nominated for The Actor® may use the words 'SAG Awards Nominee,' 'Screen Actors Guild Award Nominee' or similar descriptions incorporating SAG-AFTRA marks and may use a depiction of The Actor® statuette provided multiple conditions are met.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conditions: (i) Depiction appears only during period between nomination and presentation of that year’s awards, and no more than once per advertisement; (ii) Size of depiction does not exceed ten percent of total advertising space or viewing area; (iii) SAG-AFTRA approves quality of representation; (iv) The copyright, trademark, and service mark notice, '©1995 SAG-AFTRA,' accompanies depiction in legible form; (v) The word 'Nomination(s)' or 'Nominated for' appear in the same size, style, and color of type as the marks 'SAG Awards' or 'Screen Actors Guild Awards'; and (vi) The achievement for which the nomination has been received is specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on advertising non-awarded achievements as awards
rubrics_metrics.description: No performing achievement that has not received The Actor® may be advertised or exploited in a manner which will mislead the public or imply by design, layout or wording of copy that the performer has received such an award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: During the first quarter of the Screen Actors Guild Award year, no individual may be advertised as a 'SAG Award Nominee' or 'Screen Actors Guild Awards Nominee' except in advertising for the film in which the performance received the nomination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Packaging: prohibition on using marks/symbols on sold items (with exceptions)
rubrics_metrics.description: No Screen Actors Guild Award mark, nor any photograph or drawing that includes a reproduction of a Screen Actors Guild Award symbol or SAG-AFTRA mark, may be used on, as part of, or affixed to any item that is sold to the public, including video cassettes and discs, audio records or any commercial goods, whether or not in connection with a current or previous recipient of The Actor® except as specifically allowed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exceptions and their precise conditions are detailed below for packaging of video cassettes/discs and labeling of motion picture packaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Packaging exception: depiction on video cassette/disc for films with Actor® recipient (conditions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Video cassettes and discs of motion pictures that have a performer who received The Actor® may include a depiction of The Actor® statuette on their packaging under specified conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conditions: (i) It appears no more than once on each package; (ii) The size of the depiction does not exceed one inch in height; (iii) SAG-AFTRA approves the quality of the presentation; (iv) The copyright notice, '© 1995 SAG-AFTRA,' accompanies the depiction in legible form; and (v) The award year and the category 'Outstanding Performance' are indicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Packaging wording: 'Winner'/'Nominee' statements on video packaging (conditions and credit)
rubrics_metrics.description: The words 'SAG Awards Winner,' 'Screen Actors Guild Award Recipient,' 'The Actor Nominee,' and 'SAG Award Nominee' or similar descriptions may appear on video cassettes and disc packaging of any motion picture that has a performer in the cast who has received The Actor® statuette or nomination under specified conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conditions: (i) The motion picture actually has a performer in the cast who received The Actor® or a SAG Award nomination; (ii) The award year for which the performer won or was nominated is indicated; (iii) The terms 'Nomination(s),' 'Nominee(s),' and/or 'Nominated for' appear in the same size, style and color of type as the marks 'The Actor' and/or 'Screen Actors Guild Award'; and (iv) SAG-AFTRA marks appear with appropriate notice of trademark and service mark ownership and registration and credit is given to SAG-AFTRA as the owner (specified credit phrasing provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial/news use: copyright notice required
rubrics_metrics.description: News and editorial uses of Screen Actors Guild Awards symbols and SAG-AFTRA marks in stories and articles appearing in newspapers, periodicals, digital publications and on television or mini-motion pictures are subject to the condition that all published representations of The Actor® statuette must include the notice of copyright, '© 1995 SAG-AFTRA.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editorial uses are permitted only with the required copyright notice present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial/news use: marks may not describe other organizations' awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Neither the marks 'Screen Actors Guild Award,' 'SAG Awards,' nor 'The Actor' may be used to describe awards given by organizations other than SAG-AFTRA or legacy Screen Actors Guild.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use SAG-AFTRA marks or names to label or describe awards from other organizations.
